body:
Founder real-time: helm support into DUNG and project BURROW. Real trigger: PARENA's new stdlib/k8s+helm packages needed struct types. A registered defstruct emits a real exported Go struct type; get-field lowers to plain dot access. Construction deliberately not emitted -- a real host constructs via ordinary Go composite literals, matching the C target's own real split. Real boundary found: k8s.prn/helm.prn's String+Arena string-building is incompatible with the Go target's GC-off-safe design; stdlib/k8s/scaling.prn (scalar-only) proves the new struct support end to end. go test: 50/50. BURROW commit aad0fc8.

⚓ ☃
title: defstruct + get-field support for the Go emission target
